name: Metric-Phase Fields (MPF)
aliases: Gated-Metric Formulation with Residual Phase Injection
definition: MPFs decouple metric proximity from phase/sign information by learning two continuous fields: an unsigned metric field r(x) >= 0 and a phase field theta(x). The phase field induces a bounded indicator P(x) = tanh(beta * theta(x)) in (-1, 1). The composite field is phi(x) = r(x)P(x) + theta(x). The surface is the zero level set {x : phi(x) = 0}. This allows handling sign-ambiguous geometry (thin sheets, open boundaries) while maintaining signed behavior for rendering.
